modmenu.descriptionTranslation.survival_: Adds useful Carpet rules for survival servers.
survival_aid.rule.survivalAidCreeperGrie: Creeper explosions do not destroy blocks, but still deal damage and knockback to entities.
survival_aid.rule.survivalAidDeathCoordi: Sends the dimension and coordinates to the player upon death.
survival_aid.rule.survivalAidAutoEatFood: Automatically consumes food from inventory when hunger drops to or below the threshold. Only plain food is eaten; potions, milk, honey bottles, chorus fruit, suspicious stew and enchanted golden apples are skipped.
Shows debug messages for auto eat food decisions.
survival_aid.rule.survivalAidDisableVill: Prevents cats from spawning in villages due to occupied beds.
survival_aid.rule.survivalAidLowDurabili: Warns when main hand item durability is at or below this value. Set to 0 to disable.
survival_aid.rule.survivalAidLowHealthGl: Makes player glow when health is at or below the threshold.
Health threshold for low health glow.
survival_aid.rule.survivalAidNoCrammingE: Comma-separated list of entity IDs immune to cramming damage.
survival_aid.rule.survivalAidStackingOpt: Comma-separated list of entity IDs that skip push calculation when stacked.
survival_aid.rule.survivalAidInstantItem: Items are picked up instantly (0 tick delay) when touched.
survival_aid.rule.survivalAidItemPickupF: Comma-separated whitelist of item IDs for pickup. Set to none or empty to allow all.
survival_aid.rule.survivalAidPlayerItemP: Restricts a player to only pick up whitelisted items. Use /survivalaid pickup allow <item> <player>. Example: /survivalaid pickup allow diamond awa.
Shows debug messages for player item pickup whitelist checks.
survival_aid.rule.survivalAidTntLikeBloc: When triggered by redstone, flint and steel, fire charge, or burning projectiles, blocks explode like TNT.
survival_aid.rule.survivalAidVisitorPlay: Comma-separated list of player names or UUIDs. Visitors cannot break, place, or use blocks or interact with entities.
survival_aid.rule.survivalAidVisitorNoIt: Visitor players cannot pick up items.
survival_aid.rule.survivalAidNetherPorta: Since 1.21.5 the nether portal teleport range follows the outline box (central pillar only), making teleportation hard to trigger. Restores the full-block teleport check while keeping the vanilla visuals. (1.21.5 only)
survival_aid.rule.survivalAidNoEndermanG: Endermen cannot pick up or place blocks, nor pick up block-form items.
survival_aid.rule.survivalAidPreventTool: Stops using main hand tool when durability reaches the threshold.
Durability threshold for tool break prevention.
survival_aid.rule.survivalAidVoidPlayerR: Rescues players falling into the void.
Trigger Y coordinate for void rescue.
Cooldown for void rescue in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second).
survival_aid.rule.survivalAidWorkstation: Sneak right-click a villager to highlight its workstation with a glowing block entity.
survival_aid.rule.survivalAidBotMinecart: When enabled, bots dismount from minecarts before being killed/removed, preventing minecart loss or duplication.
survival_aid.rule.survivalAidFakePlayerI: When enabled, /survivalaid searchitem <item> searches which fake players (online and offline) carry the given item and how much.
survival_aid.rule.survivalAidFakePlayerS: Scan All Offline Fake Player Data
When off (default), offline fake players are recognized by the survivalaid_fake tag and get tagged; when on, all offline player data is scanned directly without distinction.
survival_aid.rule.survivalAidInstantHopp: When enabled, hoppers attempt to transfer items every tick (0 tick cooldown).
survival_aid.rule.survivalAidProjectionF: When enabled, /survivalaid fill reads the .litematic projection in the server's schematics/ directory and distributes the required block items from the executor's inventory into all containers within 4 blocks. Disabled by default.
survival_aid.rule.survivalAidFillExclude: Item IDs skipped when filling projection containers with /survivalaid fill (comma-separated, minecraft: prefix optional). Default excludes minecraft:blue_ice.
survival_aid.message.auto_eat_skip_coold: Skipped: auto eat cooldown, %s ticks left
survival_aid.message.auto_eat_no_food: Not eaten: food stacks=%s, skipped special consumables=%s, hunger=%s

survival_aid.message.void_rescue_no_rock: Void rescue: no firework rockets in your inventory.
survival_aid.message.void_rescue_used: Void rescue: automatically %sused a firework rocket.
